attributes.action: For GPs to refer children to specialists sooner after worsening symptoms
attributes.additional_details: The current state of our GP practices failed our family and we have suffered because of it with lifelong issues, if things get put in place sooner many other families won't have to suffer the way we did, so this petition is so close to my heart and we as parents need our worries heard and not be brushed off, too often GPs assume a child has a viral infection when infact making assumptions especially with worsening symptoms can cost a child their life and nearly did on this occasion
attributes.background: I would like to make it a law in all of the uk that GPs have to refer children to a specialist if they don't understand what's going on after a number of visits and worsening symptoms, parents understand their children more than anybody and their concerns shouldn't go ignored

rejection.details:
We're very sorry to hear about the problems your family has faced. However, your petition is about something that the Welsh Government and Welsh Parliament is responsible for. That means that the UK Government and Parliament can't look into it.

The Welsh Parliament has its own Petitions Committee. If you'd like to send your petition to the Welsh Parliament, you can find out more here: https://petitions.senedd.wales/

You may also wish to raise this issue with your local Members of the Senedd who represent you. You can find out who your Members of the Senedd are and how to contact them here: https://senedd.wales/find-a-member-of-the-senedd/
